title: ui-confirm: create AntithesisQuality indicator
description: Create an AntithesisQuality indicator component that visually displays the quality score of a user's antithesis. This component provides immediate feedback on how effectively the antithesis challenges the problem statement, using color coding and numeric scores to communicate quality levels.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL display a quality score between 0 and 100
THE SYSTEM SHALL use color coding to indicate quality level (red/yellow/green)

event_driven.trigger: WHEN an antithesis quality score is calculated
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL update the indicator with animated transition

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the quality score changes significantly
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide contextual feedback explaining the change

unwanted.condition: IF the quality score calculation fails
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT display an incorrect or stale score
unwanted.because: misleading quality indicators can cause poor decision making

unwanted.condition: IF the score is being recalculated
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT show a frozen indicator without loading state
unwanted.because: users need to know when data is being processed

preconditions: Quality calculation service must be available
Component must receive a valid antithesis reference or content
postconditions: Quality score is displayed with appropriate visual styling
Score reflects the most recent calculation result
invariants: Quality score is always displayed as a value between 0-100
Color mapping remains consistent (low=red, medium=yellow, high=green)

happy: Given a high-quality antithesis, when displayed, then shows green indicator with score above 70
Given a medium-quality antithesis, when displayed, then shows yellow indicator with score between 40-70
Given a low-quality antithesis, when displayed, then shows red indicator with score below 40
error: Given a calculation error, when displayed, then shows an error state with retry option
Given a null antithesis reference, when rendered, then shows a neutral/unknown state
Given an outdated score, when new calculation completes, then transitions smoothly to new value

phase_2: Create AntithesisQuality component with score prop
Add color coding logic based on score range

similar: See ConfidenceBadge component for indicator patterns
